scripts.lint: cd native/FedChairmanGame && swiftformat Sources Tests --swift-version 6.1 --lint && swiftlint lint --strict
scripts.test:ui: mkdir -p /tmp/fed-chairman-visual-smoke && chmod 777 /tmp/fed-chairman-visual-smoke && cd native/FedChairmanGame && xcodebuild test -project FedChairmanGameNative.xcodeproj -scheme FedChairmanGameNative -destination 'platform=macOS'
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:gui
scripts.verify:desktop:xcuitest: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:ui
